% titlesec's default spacing (option aftersep): a heading right after
% another heading has only the space below the first, as
% \ttl@straight@ii adds no space above while \if@nobreak holds. A section
% after a part, with the section's space from \titlespacing*, a subsection
% after a section, and a paragraph on a line of its own after a
% subsubsection.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{6ex plus 1ex minus .2ex}{2.5ex plus .2ex}
\titleformat{\paragraph}[block]{\normalfont\bfseries}{\theparagraph}{1em}{}
\titlespacing*{\paragraph}{0pt}{3ex}{1ex}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{4}
\begin{document}
Some text before the first part.
\part{Beginnings}
\section{After the part}
Some text in the section.
\section{A section}
\subsection{After the section}
Some text in the subsection.
\subsubsection{A subsubsection}
\paragraph{After the subsubsection}
Some text in the paragraph.
\end{document}
